init_DrQA_retriever: initialize a DrQA TF-IDF retriever with a model path and number of threads
feed_data_to_DrQA: feed query data into the DrQA retriever for chunked multi-threaded processing
run_DrQA_retriever: run the DrQA retriever to return Wikipedia document provenance for each query
get_predictions_thread: get TF-IDF document predictions for a batch of queries using a ranker
review_DrQA_class: review the DrQA class that extends Retriever for multi-threaded TF-IDF document retrieval
